notes.title: Decision to Postpone Release
notes.content:
[h3]Today I made the decision with a heavy heart to postpone the planned release to October 2025.[/h3]

As the initially planned release date approached fast, I felt the pressure rising to ship [b]CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134[/b] in a state I would consider finished, but not reflecting the true potential I see in it.

While the content of the game should be ready around the time I initially planned to release, there is still more I can do to [b]improve and polish[/b] in significant ways.

Thanks to your awesome feedback in the several past months I really found out in what direction I should push the game and some [b]features got added[/b] to the previously already far advanced project. I want to give you the best game CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 can be. And that unfortunately takes me longer than I anticipated.

I want to apologize for not keeping the schedule and I hope you stick with me a few more months until I will release the absolute best version of the game in [b]October 2025[/b].

[h3]I'll try to keep you informed about the game’s state at all times.[/h3]
I also just started a devlog video series on the FiendGames YouTube channel, where you can follow the development and get some exclusive insights into the process of creating CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134. 
[b]
Take care and see you soon![/b]
Gabriel Mittermair
Fiend Games

notes.title: VR Blink Teleport, Performance and French Localization
notes.content:
The THIRD MAJOR UPDATE to CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 Demo just dropped consisting of a new VR Locomotion, French Localization, bug fixes and additional Achievements!

[h1]Patch Log - CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 – DEMO (Version 1.3):[/h1]

[h2]Overall Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Two New Achievements
[*] Additional Language: French
[*] Significantly improve Performance on Progress Actions and Loading
[/list]

[h2]New Gameplay Mechanic for VR:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Blink Teleport Locomotion
[/list]

[h2]VR Specific Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Better Physics Hand Position
[/list]

[h2]And Many Minor Bug Fixes[/h2]


This will most likely be the last major update for the demo, since I will now fully focus on the development of the full game! You can still expect minor bug fixes and urgent changes. 

Your feedback and support already improved the game significantly!
Can’t wait to show you more! 

In the meantime [b][i]+Wishlist[/i][/b], [b][i]+Follow[/i][/b] and [b][i]consider leaving a Review[/i][/b] on the Demo Store Page after playing.

[h2]Thank you![/h2]

notes.title: New Mechanics, Features and Supported Languages
notes.content:
Happy Halloween, Fiends! 

[h2]Patch Log - CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 – DEMO (Version 1.1):[/h2]

[h3]New Gameplay Mechanics for PC:[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Move In/Out Grabbed Objects 
[*] Rotate Grabbed Objects 
[*] Throw Grabbed Objects 
[*] Crouch 
[*] Lean Left/Right 
[/list]

[h3]PC Specific Design Improvements: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Improve Object Grabbing Behaviour 
[*] Rework Dart Throwing 
[*] Improve Door Opening Behaviour
[/list] 

[h3]New Gameplay Mechanic for VR: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Smooth Turn 
[/list]

[h3]New UI Settings for VR: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Smooth Turn Rate 
[*] Rumble Intensity
[/list] 

[h3]VR Specific Bug Fixes: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix VR Default Locomotion to be (yet unreleased) Teleport Locomotion 
[/list]

[h3]Overall Improvements: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Additional Tutorials and Input Prompts 
[*] Missile Crane now has a minimum travel distance when moving it out of the hatch, which should hint to Holding the Button. 
[*] Letters in Break Room now have Checkmarks on them to better communicate that those are have been read already. 
[/list]

[h3]Many Minor Bug Fixes[/h3]

[h3]Additional Supported Languages: [/h3]
[list]
[*] SPANISH
[*] BRAZILIAN PORTUGUESE
[*] RUSSIAN 
[/list]

Most [b]Changes and Bug Fixes[/b] were implemented according to [b]your Feedback[/b]!

[h3]Thank you![/h3]
